definitions.explanation: To physically remove something unwanted from a place or object.

definitions.gloss: to eliminate; to get rid of
definitions.explanation: To eliminate abstract things like problems, obstacles, or concerns.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}の{雑草|ざっそう}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いた。
examples.english: I removed the weeds from the garden.

examples.japanese: {不安|ふあん}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}くために、{何度|なんど}も{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: I explained many times to eliminate their concerns.

examples.japanese: この{洗剤|せんざい}は{頑固|がんこ}な{汚|よご}れをきれいに{取|と}り{除|のぞ}くことができる。
examples.english: This detergent can cleanly remove stubborn stains.

notes:
{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}) formed from {取|と}る (to take) + {除|のぞ}く (to exclude/remove). It emphasizes completely removing something unwanted.

ASPECT (ている):
{取|と}り{除|のぞ}いている indicates the action is in progress. The resulting state is often expressed with {取|と}り{除|のぞ}いてある or passive forms.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [object]を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く — to remove [object]
- [place]から[object]を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く — to remove [object] from [place]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {障害|しょうがい}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (remove obstacles)
- {不安|ふあん}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (eliminate anxiety)
- {汚|よご}れを{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (remove dirt)
- {原因|げんいん}を{取|と}り{除|のぞ}く (eliminate the cause)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {除去|じょきょ}する: to remove (more formal, technical)
- {排除|はいじょ}する: to exclude, eliminate (stronger nuance)
